decisive_items: bone discontinuity of the maxillary, septal, sphenoid, ethmoidal walls, and pterygopalatine fossa
response.rationale: Destructive sino-orbital process with markedly elevated inflammatory markers and nonspecific chronic fibrosing inflammation best fits granulomatosis with polyangiitis (Wegener's); the other candidates require neoplasia or fungi that were not identified.

rejected.why: Lymphoma is suggested by frozen section but permanent sections show no neoplasia.
Metastasis would require neoplasia; biopsy is negative and sinonasal metastasis from cervical cancer is unlikely.
Esthesioneuroblastoma is a neoplasm; biopsy shows no neoplasia and lacks specific olfactory location support.
Squamous cell carcinoma is a neoplasm; biopsy shows no neoplasia.
Sinusoidal lymphoma is not supported by the sinonasal/orbital location and biopsy shows no neoplasia.
Sinonasal lymphoma fits imaging and frozen section but final biopsy shows no neoplasia; less likely than an inflammatory/vasculitic process.
Invasive fungal sinusitis is a concern in diabetes, but biopsy shows no fungi and the 5-month course is slowly progressive.
